set.body:
Supporting track: Run. Owner task.

Acceptance
1. A Linux host inside the institute network that we control. A lab server is enough: at least 4 cores and 16 GB of memory; storage of three times the pilot study; a second disk or share for backups; Docker, or Java 21 with PostgreSQL 17.
2. A DNS name and a TLS certificate that browsers inside the institute accept, or an agreed interim.
3. A named research-IT contact who knows the host exists, even informally.
4. For the pitch, not for the MVP: what IT says an institutional machine and single sign-on would take. Record it here.
set.title: RUN1: Secure a host on the institute network and an IT contact
